captions.detailed: This 3D model represents a front steering and rack assembly for a cargo bicycle. It features a wide pair of curved steel fork blades, a threadless straight steerer tube, and a riser stem holding wide flat handlebars with end grips. Bolted to the fork blades is a front cargo rack platform with silver metallic slats. The assembly is mounted to a simplified black head-tube frame section, allowing the entire fork, rack, and handlebar assembly to rotate as a single unit on a revolute steering axis.
captions.instruction: Generate a CadQuery model of a cargo bike front fork assembly. It should include a head-tube frame mount, a rotating steerer tube with wide flat handlebars, and a curved fork with an integrated front cargo rack featuring silver slats.
captions.factory: The code constructs a multi-part articulated assembly. It first creates a fixed base frame representing the head tube using box and cylinder primitives. It then models the rotating fork assembly (steerer tube, stem, handlebars with grips, and curved unicrown fork blades) using cylinders, swept profiles, and mirrored geometries. The front cargo rack is built using a combination of thin cylinders for the support struts and a series of silver-colored rectangular slats. Finally, a revolute joint is defined along the head-tube axis to connect the steering assembly to the fixed frame.
